subject: Coverage & onboarding logistics: Diego Fernandez as interim Platform Manager
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Proposal — Diego to cover Platform Manager while Priya is on parental leave

Team,

Quick note to propose Diego stepping in as interim manager for Platform starting 2025-10-01 while Priya is on parental leave (expected 12 weeks). Diego has been acting tech lead on the infra rewrite and has been running 1:1s with several of the impacted ICs, so operationally this should be the lowest-friction option.

Key asks:
- HR: can we push the internal assignment / manager status through for an interim effective 2025-10-01? (Mina)
- People Ops: confirm compensation band impact (if any) and whether a formal promotion packet is needed now vs after Priya returns (Laura/Mina)
- Managers: agree on direct-report reassignments and on-call drip coverage for the first two weeks while Diego ramps (Grace/Vivek)

Attached: org_chart_platform_q4.pdf, promotion_summary_diego.docx, manager_handover_template.xlsx

I recommend a 30-minute sync on Friday to lock dates and owners. Diego — appreciate a short note on readiness and any blockers.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Product & Platform
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: org_chart_platform_q4.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: promotion_summary_diego.docx (DOCX)]
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — Diego to cover Platform Manager while Priya is on parental leave

Thanks for the context, Marissa. HR checklist and next steps below: 

1) Interim manager assignment: we can process an interim manager appointment effective 2025-10-01. Please confirm the length (tentatively 12 weeks).
2) Compensation: if this is a temporary assignment with no title change, we typically do not change base salary; if you want an interim stipend or formal promotion, we need a promotion packet. Laura — can you confirm preferred path?
3) People Ops forms: I'll need the manager handover template completed (attached), the updated org chart PDF to be saved into Diego's file, and a signed manager responsibilities acknowledgment.
4) Training: recommend scheduling CoachPro Manager Essentials (2 x 90m sessions) the week of 10/6 for a quick primer. CoachPro contact cc'd for scheduling.

I'll start a People Ops ticket and tag payroll for the effective date. If anyone wants a formal approval record, I can route a DocuSign for the interim appointment.

Mina Haddad
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: manager_handover_template.xlsx (XLSX)]
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 09:00:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — Diego to cover Platform Manager while Priya is on parental leave

All — I support this plan. Diego has repeatedly stepped into coordination duties during the infra outages and has strong rapport across the team. Two follow-ups:

1) Can Diego confirm direct reports that will move to him starting 10/1 (please include any stretch 1:1s that might stay with other leads)?
2) I'd like a short transition doc in Confluence outlining the immediate priorities (calendar, on-call rotation, 1:1 schedule, open hiring interviews to pause/carry). Diego, ping me when you drop that in; I'll join the first 30 minutes of your handoff sync to set expectations.

Let's use Friday 9/19 10:00 AM ET for the final coordination call (30 min). Mina — please confirm payroll and whether we need a DocuSign for an interim manager acknowledgement.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 13:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — Diego to cover Platform Manager while Priya is on parental leave

Thanks everyone — I accept the interim coverage and the 10/01 start date. Quick status and blockers: 

- Direct reports I will assume on 10/1: Anjali Rao, Samir Patel, and Karthik Iyengar. I'll leave the performance improvement case for one teammate with Vivek for now (per prior discussion).
- Open interviews: I'll pause scheduling for the backend hire in week 1 and keep the candidate funnel warm.
- Ramp blockers: I need a calendar access change for Priya's shared inbox and the PagerDuty rotation to be reassigned (Mina — can you coordinate with Ops?).

I'll draft the Confluence transition doc today and invite Grace + Marissa to comment. Looking forward to the CoachPro sessions — please send the scheduling options.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Staff Engineer (acting interim)
Redwood Inference
